A client (the referer check is a client-supplied header) that varies the path on embeddable_host bypasses the throttle entirely, driving unbounded server-side fetch+import jobs and unbounded topic creation from a public endpoint.

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds a public GET /embed/best endpoint (routes.rb) that, on cache miss (no TopicEmbed for params[:embed_url]), unconditionally enqueues Jobs::RetrieveTopic (EmbedController#best) with no rate limiting at enqueue time. RetrieveTopic -> TopicRetriever does have throttling, but it keys on the full URL string (`retrieved_key = "retrieved:#{@embed_url}"` in TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently?), so varying the path/query on the allowed host bypasses the 60s throttle entirely while still passing the host check (`SiteSetting.embeddable_host != URI(@embed_url).host`). Since `ensure_embeddable` relies on `request.referer` (client-supplied header) for authorization, a non-browser client can spoof it and drive repeated server-side `open(url)` fetches and `TopicEmbed.import_remote` / `TopicEmbed.import` topic creation for many distinct URLs on the embeddable host.
